entities.summary: The Sydney Cricket Ground (SCG) is a sports stadium in the Moore Park suburb of Sydney, New South Wales, Australia. It is used for Test, One Day International and Twenty20 cricket, as well as, Australian rules football and occasionally for rugby league, rugby union and association football. It is the home ground for the New South Wales Blues cricket team, the Sydney Sixers of the Big Bash League and the Sydney Swans of the Australian Football League. It is owned and operated by Venues NSW, an agency of the Government of New South Wales who also hold responsibility for Stadium Australia and the Sydney Football Stadium.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: The Sydney Cricket Ground has played a significant role in Australian sports history, hosting numerous high-profile cricket matches and serving as a venue for international sporting events. Its construction in 1853 marked the beginning of modern sports infrastructure in Australia.
